name: Divya Villa, Kumbalangi
summary: Stay at Divya Villa in Kumbalangi, Kochi: an entire private home for 8 guests with 4 AC bedrooms, 6 beds, 4 bathrooms, kitchen, free Wi-Fi and private parking near the backwaters.
description:
## Welcome to Divya Villa.

Experience the beauty and tranquillity of Kerala at Divya Villa, a spacious, stylish and serene four-bedroom air-conditioned private villa in the peaceful surroundings of Kumbalangi, Kochi, close to the beautiful backwaters.

Perfect for families and groups of friends, the entire home comfortably accommodates up to eight guests, offering privacy, comfort and plenty of space to relax.

## Your home away from home

- 4 comfortable bedrooms

- 6 beds

- 4 bathrooms

- Air conditioning in the bedrooms

- Spacious living areas

- Fully equipped kitchen

- Dining area

- Free Wi-Fi

- Private parking

- Peaceful Kerala surroundings

- Close to Kumbalangi backwaters

## Discover Kumbalangi

Escape the busy city and experience the authentic beauty of Kerala. Kumbalangi is known for its peaceful backwaters, coconut palms, fishing villages, traditional Chinese fishing nets and relaxed village atmosphere.

## Explore Kochi
Divya Villa is a peaceful base for exploring Kochi’s popular attractions.

- Fort Kochi — Historic streets, cafés and Chinese fishing nets.

- Mattancherry Palace — Kochi’s rich history and architecture.

- Jew Town & Paradesi Synagogue — Historic streets, antique shops and boutiques.

- Marine Drive — Waterfront views and evening walks.

- Kerala Folklore Museum — Traditional art, culture and architecture.

- Cherai Beach — A relaxing day by the sea.

- Kochi City Centre — Shopping, restaurants and entertainment.

## Perfect for families and groups

With four bedrooms and four bathrooms, Divya Villa is ideal for families and groups who prefer staying together in a private home rather than separate hotel rooms.

Whether you’re visiting Kochi for sightseeing, a family holiday, a wedding, a special occasion or simply a peaceful break, Divya Villa offers a comfortable and relaxing base to experience Kochi and Kumbalangi. We look forward to welcoming you to Divya Villa and Kerala.

## Guest access

Guests have exclusive access to the entire private villa, including all four bedrooms, bathrooms, living areas, dining area, kitchen and outdoor spaces. Private parking is available at the property.

Enjoy complete privacy throughout your stay. Access details, including key or lockbox instructions, will be shared before check-in.

## Other things to note

- The villa is in a peaceful residential area of Kumbalangi.

- The property is suitable for families and groups, with a maximum capacity of eight guests.

- Please respect the neighbours and maintain reasonable noise levels, especially at night.

- Please keep the property clean and treat the furniture and facilities with care.

- Check-in and check-out details will be shared before arrival.

- Please inform us in advance of any special requirements or requests.

## Plan your stay
Share your preferred dates and guest count. Our team will confirm availability, the total price and booking terms before you book.

contact@britsmaid.in
